Industrious day, salute to the front-counter team
It was a good run
Steady paws, careful hands

Our work this week at Aurelia Skyways reminds us that calm service begins with clear routines and gracious follow-through. The Companion Animal Travel Desk thanks every colleague who kept pet travel guidance steady, checked comfort notes with care, and supported travelers with the patience that such work deserves. <<FACT F048>> The senior coordinator appreciated the careful handoffs, and the welfare coordinator noted that small acts of attention made a real difference for anxious animals and their people.

We also saw good discipline in the way crews shared updates and listened closely before each departure. <<FACT F038>> That kind of plain, reliable teamwork helps Biscuit and every other companion move through the journey with less strain. We regret any missed detail, but the overall effort was strong, humane, and worth recognizing. Please keep the same thoughtful pace, because consistent care remains the best service we can offer.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
